en_title: Sony Issues Official PS5 Firmware Update Warning, Confirms GTA 6 Requirement
cn_title: 索尼发布PS5固件更新官方警告，确认《GTA6》运行要求
opus_summary: 索尼确认，PS5玩家必须安装系统软件更新14.23才能游玩《GTA6》，并建议在11月19日午夜前下载。Rockstar转发了这一消息。有观点认为，该更新会阻止旧版固件访问PlayStation Network；此次更新发布前，PS5旧版固件的越狱工具相继出现。

paragraphs.en: Sony has confirmed that the recently released PS5 firmware 14.23 update is required to play GTA 6, in a social media post boosted by Rockstar Games.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼在一则获得Rockstar转发的社交媒体帖子中确认，游玩《GTA6》需要安装最近发布的PS5 14.23固件更新。

paragraphs.en: Yesterday November 17, Sony released PS5 system software update 26.07-14.23.00 , which weighed in at 1.267 GB. According to Sony’s official patch notes, it makes “some security fixes to the system software.”
paragraphs.cn: 昨天11月17日，索尼发布了PS5系统软件更新26.07-14.23.00，大小为1.267 GB。根据索尼的官方更新说明，该更新「对系统软件进行了一些安全修复」。

paragraphs.en: Now, just hours before GTA 6 launches at midnight across the world, the PlayStation Support U.S. X / Twitter account confirmed what many had suspected: “Sony Interactive has issued a PS5 system software update that is required before playing Grand Theft Auto VI. Players should download this update prior to midnight on November 19 so that they’re ready to play on launch day, November 19.” The official Rockstar Games account then reposted it to its 23.7 million followers.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，距离《GTA6》在全球各地的午夜发售仅剩几小时，PlayStation Support美国X账号证实了许多人的猜测：「索尼Interactive已发布一项PS5系统软件更新，玩家必须安装该更新才能游玩《侠盗猎车手VI》。玩家应在11月19日午夜之前下载此更新，以便在11月19日发售当天做好游玩准备。」随后，Rockstar官方账号向其2370万粉丝转发了这则帖子。

paragraphs.en: It is believed this unprecedented PS5 update cuts PlayStation Network access to older firmware, which means if you haven’t upgraded to 14.23 you will not be able to play GTA 6 on PS5. 14.23 released just a day after a prominent PS5 hacker claimed to be the first person to have “dumped” a game binary at 14.22, although they did not share any jailbreak.
paragraphs.cn: 据信，这项前所未有的PS5更新切断了旧版固件对PlayStation Network的访问，这意味着如果没有升级到14.23，就无法在PS5上游玩《GTA6》。14.23发布的前一天，一位知名PS5黑客声称自己是首个在14.22版本上「转储」游戏二进制文件的人，不过他们并未分享任何越狱方法。

paragraphs.en: The PlayStation homebrew scene has made headlines in the last two months for releasing PS5 jailbreaks for prior firmwares. For example, late September, a jailbreak that supported all PS5 consoles running firmware 7.00-13.60 sent shockwaves through the homebrew community because, at the time, it meant that all PS5s, including the PS5 Pro, that hadn't been updated within the previous week were compatible with the jailbreak. This was of huge significance for Sony and the security of the PS5, as people with a jailbroken PS5 can modify their console, potentially opening the door to video game piracy.
paragraphs.cn: 过去两个月，PlayStation自制软件圈因发布适用于旧版固件的PS5越狱方法而成为新闻焦点。例如，9月下旬，一种支持所有运行7.00至13.60版固件的PS5主机的越狱方法在自制软件社区引发震动，因为在当时，这意味着所有在此前一周内没有更新过的PS5，包括PS5 Pro，都兼容该越狱方法。这对索尼和PS5的安全性意义重大，因为拥有已越狱PS5的人可以修改主机，可能为电子游戏盗版打开大门。

paragraphs.en: However, it was found that some PS5 games subsequently required the more recent 14.00 firmware in order to download updates, sparking a renewed effort to release a new jailbreak for the updated system software. So, there is a game of Whac-A-Mole at play where the homebrew scene is working to release a new jailbreak for the latest PS5 firmware, then do it all over again when Sony releases a new firmware update designed to beef up security.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，后来人们发现，一些PS5游戏需要较新的14.00固件才能下载更新，这促使人们再次着手为更新后的系统软件发布新的越狱方法。因此，一场打地鼠游戏正在上演：自制软件圈努力为最新的PS5固件发布新的越狱方法，然后在索尼发布旨在加强安全性的新固件更新时，再将这一过程重新来过。

paragraphs.en: This in turn has sparked concern that if a PS5 jailbreak was made available for the firmware that is required by GTA 6, then it may be possible for Rockstar’s game to be pirated on PS5 and maybe even made available on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 这又引发了担忧：如果《GTA6》所需的固件出现可用的PS5越狱方法，Rockstar的这款游戏就可能在PS5上遭到盗版，甚至可能在PC上出现。

paragraphs.en: The question for Sony is whether it can do enough to eventually win this game of Whac-A-Mole with the homebrew scene. This is something of an existential crisis for Sony, which publishers and developers rely upon for the security of their PlayStation releases. But with the emergence of powerful AI models, the stakes have risen significantly.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼面临的问题是，它能否采取足够的措施，最终赢得与自制软件圈之间的这场打地鼠游戏。对索尼而言，这在某种程度上是一场生存危机，发行商和开发商依靠索尼来保障其PlayStation发行作品的安全。但随着强大AI模型的出现，风险已显著升高。

paragraphs.en: Just last week, Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, told IGN that the company was taking security seriously , and insisted that fans will prefer to play GTA 6 officially, with all its bells and whistles as Rockstar intended, over an unofficial PC version.
paragraphs.cn: 就在上周，Rockstar母公司Take-Two的首席执行官Strauss Zelnick告诉IGN，公司正在认真对待安全问题，并坚称相比非官方PC版本，粉丝会更愿意通过官方途径游玩《GTA6》，体验Rockstar原本设想的所有功能和精彩内容。

paragraphs.en: During an investor-focused Q&A, Zelnick was asked multiple times about this AI reverse-engineering problem. He, again, had strong words in response, suggesting Take-Two was ready to lawyer up.
paragraphs.cn: 在一场面向投资者的问答环节中，Zelnick多次被问及这一AI逆向工程问题。他再次以强硬措辞回应，暗示Take-Two已准备好诉诸法律。

paragraphs.en: “This business has been largely immune to piracy concerns forever because of file sizes, complexity of piracy, being connected to servers and the like,” he began. “And undoubtedly, it would be very difficult to replicate the experience of consuming our game as intended because of technical limitations.
paragraphs.cn: 他开头说道：「由于文件大小、盗版的复杂性、需要连接服务器等因素，这个行业一直以来基本上不受盗版问题影响。毫无疑问，由于技术限制，将很难复制按我们设想的方式体验游戏的感受。

paragraphs.en: “That said, it's going to become more of a challenge, as you said, and we're aware of that. So we are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defenses and enhancing our legal activities appropriately. And at the same time, without in any way being cavalier, every entertainment business that exists is subject to some element of piracy. So this is likely to invade our business to a greater or lesser extent. I think it will be manageable and we are focused on it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「话虽如此，正如你所说，这将变得更具挑战性，我们也意识到了这一点。因此，我们正全力加强技术防御，并适当地加强法律行动。同时，我们绝不是在掉以轻心，每一家娱乐企业都在某种程度上面临盗版问题。所以，这很可能会或多或少地侵入我们的业务。我认为这将是可控的，我们正在关注这个问题。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, and some companies have even given staff bonus time off to play it . We've got plenty more on GTA 6 ahead of its November 19 launch, including details on the New Zealand trick people are using to play early, Gangland Tales From the Frontline of Rockstar's Real-Life Grand Theft Auto Research , and — finally — confirmation of the actress who plays Lucia .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》预计将成为有史以来规模最大的娱乐产品发售，有些公司甚至给员工额外放假，让他们游玩这款游戏。在《GTA6》于11月19日发售之前，我们还有大量相关内容，包括人们用来提前游玩的新西兰技巧的详细信息、《Rockstar现实版〈侠盗猎车手〉调研前线的黑帮故事》，以及——终于——扮演Lucia的女演员身份的确认。
